title: Stock Markets Slip as Nvidia and A.I. Stocks Erase Some of Monday’s Rally
summary: Shares have veered wildly for days, pushed and pulled by the drama at Nvidia and the rise and fall of Anthropic’s stock after its blockbuster public offering.
